display_long_description:
# 🚨 WIZHERD FULL RELEASE IS HERE! 🚨
[media]
# 🧹 NEW IN WIZHERD 🧹
- 🧹 **Brooms** – Fly across the world, reach new dungeons, and fight from the air!
- ⚙️ **Broom Customization** – Mix and match broom heads, handles, and trails.
- 🌥️ **Celestial Skies Dungeon** - Test your aerial skills in a brand-new unique dungeon built specifically around the brand new broom flying mechanics!
- 📦 **Season 3** – New rings, brooms, and cosmetics to unlock!
- ⏱️ **Dungeon Time Trials** - Race against the clock and compare your fastest times on the new leaderboards!
- 📜 **Quest Journal** - Read and track your active quests anywhere directly from your inventory.

[media]

Wizherd is a fast-paced VR wizard game where you cast spells with your own hands. Blast through waves of enemies, explore dungeons, and take down giant bosses in this magic dungeon crawler.
[media]
Build your wizard with unique spells, perks, and enchanted rings. Play solo or team up with friends in online co-op. Every run brings new enemies, new loot, and new ways to become a legendary spellcaster.

**Key Features:**
- ✨ **Hand-Cast Spells** – Aim and throw magic with real hand motions.
- 🌍 **Open World** – Explore a growing world full of tougher, smarter enemies.
- 🏰 **Dungeon Difficulty Tiers** – Push through rising difficulty and harder bosses.
- 🤝 **Co-op Multiplayer** – Play with friends in public or private lobbies.
- 🔮 **Deep Build Customization** – Combine spells, perks, and rings to fit your playstyle.
- 🧥 **Wardrobe System** – Customize your wizard's look with robes, hats, and cosmetics.
